name.full: Zava Claims - One MCP, Two Experiences

description.short: Explore synthetic Zava claims through Cowork and a focused Copilot agent.
description.full: Session demo: one Entra-protected MCP server exposes synthetic insurance claims, inspections, and contractors. Cowork uses the packaged connector and claims-review skill; the Zava Claims Assistant uses the same server as an agent-scoped action.

agentConnectors.description: Live synthetic Zava home-insurance claims in USD, claim status and reserves, inspections, and available contractors. Use for claims analysis and operations questions. Per-user access is restricted to assigned North/South regions. Read-only; no claim approvals or payments.
